'''Tormin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Frellder]] went missing there, and investigation found that Frellder's own men had killed him due to his harsh style of command.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Missing General}}</ref>
